gloss: attic; loft; space under the roof

definitions.gloss: attic; loft; space under the roof
definitions.explanation: The space between the ceiling of the top floor and the roof of a building. May be used for storage or converted into a living space.

examples.japanese: {屋根裏|やねうら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧しまった。
examples.english: I stored luggage in the attic.

examples.japanese: {屋根裏|やねうら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{改装|かいそう}→改装：09682_kaisou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We converted the attic into a room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{屋根裏|やねうら}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧や⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: Old photos and letters were found in the attic of the old house.

notes:
{屋根裏|やねうら} is the space between the ceiling of the top floor and the roof. Composed of ⟦{屋根|やね}→屋根：02264_yane⟧ (roof) + ⟦{裏|うら}→裏：02178_ura⟧ (back/underside).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {屋根裏|やねうら}⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧: attic room (converted living space)
- {屋根裏|やねうら}⟦{収納|しゅうのう}→収納：07497_shuunou⟧: attic storage
- {屋根裏|やねうら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧: to go up to the attic
- {屋根裏|やねうら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧しまう: to store things in the attic

USAGE:
In Japanese houses, {屋根裏|やねうら} is commonly used for storage. Modern houses sometimes convert the space into a ⟦ロフト→ロフト：06771_rofuto⟧ (loft) for living use. In older traditional houses, {屋根裏|やねうら} may be quite spacious.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦ロフト→ロフト：06771_rofuto⟧: loft (used living space under the roof)
- ⟦{天井裏|てんじょううら}→天井裏：23106_tenjouura⟧: above the ceiling (similar concept, structural focus)
- ⟦{地下室|ちかしつ}→地下室：12047_chikashitsu⟧: basement (opposite location in a building)
